purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

code_family.code: Egyptian Code for Design and Execution Requirements for Building Sanitary Installations, Part 1, 301/1 (2003); related Egyptian water/sanitary network codes.
code_family.important_scope_note: The HBRC public catalogue confirms 301/1 (2003) and related sanitary-installation volumes. Exact current project requirements must be checked against the licensed/current edition and project authority requirements.

rules.condition: Potable water piping is interconnected with contaminated/nonpotable water without approved protection.
rules.action: Separate systems and provide the protection required by the governing Egyptian sanitary-installation requirements.
rules.reference: Egyptian Building Sanitary Installations Code 301/1 (2003), water-supply provisions

rules.condition: Building water demand/pressure is not demonstrated for the building's sanitary fixtures.
rules.action: Provide demand, pressure and sizing calculations using the applicable Egyptian code method/project authority requirements.
